name: Scroll-Driven Progress Bar
description: A fixed reading-progress bar at the top of the page that fills from left to right as the document scrolls, driven entirely by a native CSS Scroll Progress Timeline. Composited transform, zero JavaScript.
usage:
Include styles.css, then drop a single
right after the opening tag of any long page. Retheme per page with the --sdp-height, --sdp-fill and --sdp-z custom properties.
